Short title and commencement

ACT V OF 2010
ACT V OF 2010
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE PROVINCIAL
ASSEMBLY (POWERS, IMMUNITIES AND
PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2010
An Act further to amend the
North-West Frontier
Province Provincial Assembly
(Powers, Immunities
and
Privileges) Act, 1988
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary,
20th March, 2010]
No.PA/N.-W.F.P./Bills/2010/10573, dated 20-3-2010.---The North-West Frontier Province Provincial Assembly
(Powers, Immunities and Privileges) (Amendment) Bill, 2010 having been passed
by the Provincial Assembly of North-West Frontier Province on 11th March, 2010
and assented to by the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on 16th
March, 2010 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of
North-West Frontier Province.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient further to amend the
North-West Frontier Province Provincial Assembly (Powers, Immunities and
Privileges) Act, 1988 (N.-W.F.P. Act No. IX of 1988), for the purposes
hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:--
1. Short title and
commencement---(1) This Act may be
called the North-West Frontier Province Provincial Assembly (Powers, Immunities
and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 2010.
(2) It shall come
into force at once.

It is hereby
enacted as follows:--
2. Insertion of
new section 7, in the N.-W.F.P. Act No.IX of 1988.---After the existing section 6 of the said Act the
following new section 7 may be inserted, namely:--
"7. Power
to preside a meeting.---(1) Any
meeting convened by the Government or Semi-Government institution of autonomous
body, in which Member is supposed to
participate shall be presided over by the Member:
Provided that where
the Governor or a Federal Minister is present, the Member shall not preside
over the meeting.
(2) In case where
more than one Member is to participate in the meeting, the presiding Member
shall be;
(i) through consensus among
members; or
(ii) through voting among members."
